sourceRefs.locator: West choir overview, captions for Thimo von Kistritz and his seven villages, Hermann and Reglindis, Ekkehard II and Uta; caption dating of figures c. 1245–1250.
Uta among the twelve founders; anonymous sculptor, western choir completed around 1250 and later reception of Uta’s image.
Geographical data, property 1470rev; N51° 9′ 17.3″ and E11° 48′ 14.4″.

labels.de: Die Stifter werden in Stein sichtbar
labels.en: The founders are commemorated in stone

note.de: Im Naumburger Westchor erinnern zwölf Figuren an Wohltäter, die rund zwei Jahrhunderte vorher lebten. Die Station datiert die Arbeit der Bildhauer.
note.en: Twelve figures in the west choir at Naumburg commemorate benefactors who lived some two centuries earlier. The station dates the sculptors’ work.
